sentences.text:
Date : 11.11.2024 Heard Mr. B. Pathak, learned counsel for the petitioners; Ms. P.R. Mahanta,
learned Standing Counsel, Revenue & Disaster Management Department for the respondent nos. 1 & 2; and Mr. B. Choudhury, learned counsel for Bodoland Territorial Council [BTC] for the respondent nos. 3 & 5; and Ms. M. Barman, learned Junior Government Advocate, Assam for the respondent no. 4.
2.

The petitioners have stated that under the provisions of the Assam Fixation of Ceiling on Land Holdings Act, 1956 ['the Act', for short], a parcels of land, belonging to the predecessors' of the petitioners, came under the provisions of the Act and in the process, 678 Bighas 3 Lessas [678B-03L] had been taken over by the state vide Land Ceiling Case no. ILC.3/1972.

entities.text: Assam Fixation of Ceiling on Land Holdings Act, 1956
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Though the respondent authorities have taken those parcels of land by applying the provisions of the Act, the compensation amount for the said parcels of land have not yet been assessed and disbursed to the petitioners.

From the annexures appended to this writ petition, it transpires that communications are being exchanged among the respondent authorities about determination of the compensation amount and the process has not attained any finality till date.
It is further revealed from the annexures that the records of Ceiling Case no. ILC.3/1972 has not been traceable for a long period of time.
Aggrieved by non-determination of the compensation amounts in connection with Land Ceiling Case no. ILC.3/1972, the petitioners have preferred this writ petition.

As Ms. Mahanta, learned Standing Counsel, Revenue & Disaster Management Department has appeared and accepted notice on behalf of the respondent nos. 1 & 2; Mr. Choudhury, learned counsel for Bodoland Territorial Council [BTC] has appeared and accepted notice on behalf of the respondent Page No.# 4/4 nos. 3 & 5; and Ms. Barman, learned Junior Government Advocate,
Assam has appeared and accepted notice on behalf of the respondent no. 4, the issuance of formal notice in respect of the said respondents stands dispensed with.

However, the learned counsel for the petitioner shall furnish requisite nos. of extra copies of the writ petitioner along with annexures,
to Ms. Mahanta, Mr. Choudhury and Ms. Barman within 2 [two] working days from today.
5. The learned counsel for the respondents shall obtain and place instructions as regards the records of Land Ceiling Case no. ILC.3/1972 on the returnable date.
